stem:
Gregor Mendel studied the genetics of pea plants. He found that some pea plants produce smooth, round seeds, while other pea plants produce rough, wrinkled seeds.

Which cellular feature determines whether a pea plant produces smooth or wrinkled seeds?

options.label: A
options.text: Information located in the plasma membrane

options.label: B
options.text: Information present in chromosomes in the nucleus

options.label: C
options.text: Instructions found in proteins of the cytoplasm
